description: This Java class handles the delete command for a teller entity in the Fineract system, specifically implementing a command handler that invokes the teller write platform service to delete a teller based on the provided command.

classes.name: DeleteTellerCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing delete teller commands by invoking the teller write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command for a teller by calling the deleteTeller method on the teller write platform service with the entity ID from the command.
